patch_description: This approach maintains the proven architecture from the best prior (0.59 score) but implements the parity-split final phase recommendation. Instead of a global `rz_post` parameter on all qubits, we split into `rz_post_even` (qubits 0,2,4,6) and `rz_post_odd` (qubits 1,3,5,7). This exploits the existing even/odd symmetry of the RY layers and provides finer-grained control to separate hardest samples. By keeping the parameter count at 10 distinct parameters (same as the best prior), we maintain parameter efficiency while refining the generalization capability. The removal of the ineffective `rz_mid` layer reduces depth, convergence steps, and improves parameter economy.
